title: WHEN I LOOK INTO YOUR HOLINESS

lines.text: When I look into Your holiness,
When I gaze into Your loveliness,
When all things that surround me
Form shadows in the light of You.
When I find the joy of reaching Your heart,
When my will becomes enthroned in your life,
When all things that surround me
Form shadows in the light of You.
I worship You, I worship You } 2
The reason I live is to worship You.
